quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Anthony Edwards' role and team chemistry in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: LaMelo allows everyone else to be their best version of themselves.
quotes.quote: When I watch the game, LaMelo allows everyone else to be their best version of themselves. So Ant can just be like, I'm out here to score and defend. Jaden McDaniels and Gobert, I just got to roll and I know I'm going to get this ball. So the enthusiasm for starring in their role is a lot different. And defensively, they are already a hard-nosed team. Now everyone, the ball is popping and everyone's in their role. They're not having to divert to anybody else. They're just playing a flow of basketball that's hard to guard because you're getting a best version of everyone. But dude, I was pretty impressed for a first game. I was pretty impressed that they have the chemistry you could see getting there, and as the season goes on, these dudes are only going to get better and more dangerous.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards will lead the league in scoring this season
quotes.excerpt: Ant-Man is going to lead the league in scoring because now he has moved back to his natural position.
quotes.quote: Ant-Man is going to lead the league in scoring because now he has moved back to his natural position. He doesn't have to worry about facilitating. All he has to worry about is getting buckets.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's elite playmaking elevates his teammates' effort and energy
quotes.excerpt: When you think about throwback point guards, there's only a few that we have in this league today.
quotes.quote: When you think about throwback point guards, there's only a few that we have in this league today. Tyrese Haliburton and LaMelo Ball. Pass first, but yes, he could score. I saw everybody outside of LaMelo running and sprinting the floor with a purpose, having their hands ready with a purpose. You know why? Because they knew that the basketball was coming.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards should feel motivated by his peers' championship success
quotes.excerpt: I want you to be jealous. I want you to want what he already have.
quotes.quote: Anthony Edwards needs to be jealous. He needs to have some type of envy in him right now, because you have witnessed Luka win the championship, SGA, Jalen Brunson, and then on top of that, no matter how much love you show him, Karl-Anthony Towns won a ring. That was your former teammate, and I want you to be jealous. I want you to want what he already have, because he was with you.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Defending Brandin Podziemski for trash talking Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: The next time he sees him, go at his ass again.
quotes.quote: Everybody's going to be like, oh man, he shouldn't talk shit to Luka and I disagree with that shit 1000%. Everybody's like the rookie learned his lesson. What he learned? The next time he sees him, go at his ass again. I did watch the game and low key, he was doing a really good job defensively. So that's one. Two, they're damn near the same age. He's not a 19-year-old. This is a 24-year-old man who made it at a Yuma Arizona community college and so he's going to have a different type of attitude towards him. So I don't mind it.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr supporting his rookie against Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Steve Kerr looked at him and said, get back in the game.
quotes.quote: Also, look at who his leader is. Look at who his vet is. If you don't think, hey, when Luka said put his ass back in the game, Steve Kerr said, hey, get your ass back in the game and go guard him. I thought that was the hardest shit I've seen from a coach. They took him out because I think he got his second foul on that pump fake. Luka scored on somebody, pointed to the bench and said, get your pussy ass back in this game and Steve Kerr looked at him and said, get back in the game. And he end up making that shot at halftime.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State Warriors need an aggressive attitude to succeed
quotes.excerpt: If you're going to be a tough guy on a tough team, they need that energy.
quotes.quote: If you're going to be a tough guy on a tough team and usually Golden State's teams are good defensively, they need that energy. They're not going to be a good team without that. Think about Jimmy Butler got the same FU attitude, Draymond Green got the same FU attitude, and obviously Steve Kerr just put his rookie back in. He got the same FU attitude. So whether you like it or not, that's who they're going with and that's what they're riding for. So I actually don't think it's smart, but I appreciate it.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Trash talking and competitiveness have always defined the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The NBA is built on trash talking. We love it. That's the game.
quotes.quote: The NBA is built on trash talking. We love it. That's the game. I wasn't coming in and giving respect to other wings. I was trying to dunk on every single person that I could find. I didn't care if it was Shaq, Tim Duncan, who it's like, man, you a rookie, you just going to go? Yes. I'm here for a mission. Everybody has their own specialty where whether it's you're a defender and you want to lock it up. You're an athlete and you want to dunk on bigs. You're a big and you want to knock down threes. You're a guard and you want to crossover people. AI crossed over MJ. To make this a big deal, there's more media attention on it now, there's more stuff just covering our league, but this is what the NBA's always been.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic teaches young players lessons through elite performance
quotes.excerpt: Luka's job is to take the belt out and teach him what respect is about.
quotes.quote: Poking the bear, it's Luka's job to teach him a lesson, not for the rookie to show up and give Luka's respect. They both did their job. I'm going to show up, I'm not going to give you any respect, because I'm going to treat you like any other person. Luka's job is to take the belt out and teach him what respect is about. And that's what Luka did. And then Draymond backed it up and said, hey, do you know what your job is now after you took that belt? Your job is to see him again and to keep up and to keep going back at him. You're going to get more minutes, you got to learn, you got to stay down on defense, you got to do all the different things.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Young players must learn to focus despite Luka Doncic's antics
quotes.excerpt: You can lose all respect because he cries and whines, but he will cry and whine till 35 points.
quotes.quote: You learn lessons as in like, hey, there's nobody in college that can do what Luka did. You can lose all respect because he cries and whines, but he will cry and whine till 35 points, 10 and 10. If that's getting you out of your game, young fellow who I love, if that's getting you out of your game, then you got to adjust. He's going to work the officials, he's going to do 35, 10 and 10. If you're just going to sit over there and say he's complaining, he got 35, 10 and 10 in a win. Tim Duncan and Kevin Garnett. Kevin Garnett would say whatever he wanted to Tim Duncan, Tim Duncan would never adjust. You've got to learn how to stay within your game, not get a technical as a young player, and then you have to, which I love that he got a technical in his first game. Very similar to Draymond. Draymond got a technical on his first basket.
